citations.claim: Total energy at initial state defines E0 baseline with no controller work
Energy still near baseline one step before violation while bodies are nearly touching
First violating step: energy far exceeds allowed 4103.6 J

explanation: 100:1 mass ratio (20 vs 0.2) elastic (e=1) collision combined with floor bounce at large dt=1/30. Step 21 shows bodies nearly touching (gap 0.02) with high speeds (~15 and ~33 m/s) using ~40 substeps; resolving near-simultaneous heavy-light body collision plus ground contact in one step injects ~1335 J, jumping energy from ~3728 J to ~5064 J with zero controller work, exceeding the 10%+5J bound.
vision_note: The larger and smaller bodies converge over steps 19 to 21 until they are almost touching. In step 22 the small body suddenly appears well separated below the larger body, indicating an abrupt high-velocity ejection.
